title: Great.
text:
The course was great and the teacher sweet and very attentive. The entrance to the school is not easy to find the easiest is to have the phone d elisa.
Despite a failed RV, she moved the course to another day.
 I'd be happy to come back for a second class.
Cdt
author: Johanna_G

title: Brilliant for beginners....
text: Brilliant for beginners. The Flamenco dance teacher was lovely. She spoke very good English. I have wanted to learn some Flamenco dances for a while now. It was a great opportunity.
author: Tina_P

title: Learn the art of Flamenco with a caring teacher.
text:
Eliza is a professional Flamenco dancer and teacher, she was excellent and also knew my own Flamenco teacher in Adelaide Australia.
Highly skilled and I booked her for a private lesson the next day !
author: Lisa_P

title: Highlight of my time in Sevilla
text:
I learned so much in one hour!  My instructor was a pro Flamenco dancer who was extremely sharp at his craft and yet patient with me.  I loved it.  I went to a Pro-flamenco show that night after the class and I felt so connected to the music and dance because of this class. 
It was the highlight of my time in Sevilla.
author: Kelly_B

title: Fantastic class
text: This was such a fun class! I would highly encourage anyone visiting to sign up. Our instructor Diaz was talented, knowledgeable, and passionate.
author: Kelly_V

title: Flamenco master class
text: Fantastic experience Elisa was a lovely patient teacher as well as good humoured. We learnt a dance in the hour it was such fun. I would thoroughly recommend.
author: imogens160

title: Flamenco dance lesson
text: Fabulous dance class with Elisa. Excellent tuition for us beginners finishing with a great dance routine recorded as a memento. Highly recommend
author: jaweedag2022

title: Family experience
text: Excellent course. My two daughters (12 & 14), my wife and I registered for this class and we had a very good family dancing experience. Elisa had lots of tips and carried out a very progressive training allowing us to perform a little filmed choregraphy after just one hour of initiation.
author: Matthieu_P

title: Excellent
text: Elisa was very easy to work, very patient. My wife took the class for the first time, she throughly enjoyed it, she would like to go back if we had time in Seville.
author: Dhruv_B

title: Master Class, Flamenco Dancing
text: Elisa, my dance instructor was such a great instructor. I was her only student at that time so I got a special one-on-one instruction.
author: ntporras
